value.ambient_theory: 4-dimensional Einstein vacuum equations, Lambda = 0, classical smooth solutions
value.conclusion_predicate: AF at I+ and I+ complete and no future-incomplete causal geodesic visible from I+
exclusions: matter of any kind, Lambda != 0, more than one AF end, non-complete or closed/periodic slices
data outside the declared generic set (stationary/axisymmetric data, self-similar data, data in the exactly-extendible family) - they are non-generic members of a DIFFERENT class
conclusions about C2 or C0 inextendibility (those are SCC classes), and conclusions that the black-hole region is non-empty (separate black-hole-formation statement)
spherical symmetry or scalar matter (class AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH)
hypotheses: initial data (Sigma, h, K): Sigma connected, oriented, complete, Sigma diffeomorphic to R^3 (exactly one asymptotically flat end)
vacuum constraint equations: R(h) - |K|^2 + (tr_h K)^2 = 0 and div_h(K - (tr_h K) h) = 0
asymptotically flat decay at the rates named in F1 data_class (default: smooth-with-decay, numeric rates per derivative order; Sobolev variant s > 5/2, weight delta)
data lies in the declared generic set (residual/comeager in the named topology); genericity is part of the class, not a weakening
M = MGHD(Sigma,h,K) exists, is unique up to isometry, globally hyperbolic with Cauchy surface Sigma

negative_test_case.description: A claim that the maximal development of generic AF data is future-inextendible as a C0 Lorentzian manifold.
negative_test_case.reason: the conclusion is a C0 inextendibility statement, i.e. strong censorship content; it must not be bound to the WCC class

positive_test_case.description: Smooth one-ended AF vacuum data on Sigma = R^3, ADM mass > 0, decay at the declared rates, member of the declared generic set, whose MGHD contains a future trapped surface.
